title: TeleSales Executive - Work From Home
description:
TeleSales Executive - Work From Home (Commission-Based)

**Company:**
Smotect Private Limited (Smotect Azaadi)

**Job Location:**
Remote / Work From Home

**Job Type:**
Full-Time Availability | Commission-Based

**Working Days:**
Monday to Saturday (6 Days/Week)

**Working Hours:**
10:00 AM – 7:00 PM (IST)

**Compensation:**
100% Commission-Based (No Fixed Salary)

**Website:**
www.smotect.com

About Smotect Azaadi

Smotect Azaadi is a wellness-focused Indian company dedicated to helping people overcome smoking and tobacco habits through natural, nicotine-free alternatives.

Our product range includes Azaadi Pop, Azaadi Mix, and Azaadi Tablets, designed to support individuals on their journey towards a tobacco-free lifestyle.

We are looking for enthusiastic, confident, and result-oriented
**TeleSales Executives**
to join our remote sales team.

Job Overview

As a TeleSales Executive, your primary responsibility will be to contact potential customers, understand their needs, explain our products, and convert leads into successful sales.

**The company will provide leads. You do not need to find or generate customers yourself.**

This is a fully remote, commission-based opportunity where your earnings depend on your sales performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Contact company-provided leads through outbound calls and convert them into paying customers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable Smotect Azaadi products.
* Explain product features, benefits, pricing, and available offers clearly and professionally.
* Handle customer questions and sales objections confidently.
* Follow up with interested customers to improve conversion rates.
* Assist customers throughout the order-booking process.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, lead statuses, follow-ups, and sales.
* Work towards achieving sales and conversion targets.
* Maintain professional and empathetic communication with customers.

Work Structure & Availability

* **100% Work From Home:**
  No office attendance required.
* **Working Days:**
  Monday to Saturday.
* **Working Hours:**
  10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (IST).
* **Online Availability:**
  Candidates must remain available online during their scheduled working hours.
* **Lead Allocation:**
  New leads will be assigned only while the executive is online and available.
* **Company-Provided Leads:**
  No independent lead generation or cold prospecting required.

Eligibility & Requirements

* Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.
* Previous experience in telesales, telecalling, inside sales, or customer conversion is preferred.
* Strong communication, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to communicate confidently in Hindi and/or English.
* Good listening skills and the ability to understand customer requirements.
* Comfortable handling objections, following up with customers, and closing sales.
* Basic computer knowledge and ability to use online calling and lead-management tools.
* **Must own a personal laptop and have a stable, reliable internet connection.**
* Self-motivated, disciplined, and capable of working independently.
* Willingness to work in a 100% commission-based role.

Compensation & Commission Structure

**This is a 100% commission-based position with no fixed monthly salary.**

* Earn commission on every qualifying successful sale.
* Commission will be payable only on orders that have been successfully delivered and paid for.
* Earnings depend on individual sales performance and successful conversions.
* The applicable commission rate and payment schedule will be communicated during the selection process.

**Please apply only if you are comfortable working without a fixed salary and earning entirely through sales commissions.**

Why Join Smotect Azaadi?

* Work from home with no daily office commute.
* Receive company-generated leads without having to source customers yourself.
* Earn commissions based on your sales performance.
* Gain experience in telesales, customer communication, and sales conversion.
* Work with a growing Indian wellness brand.

How to Apply

If you are confident in your communication skills, enjoy interacting with customers, and have the ability to convert leads into sales, we would like to hear from you.

**Freshers with strong communication and convincing skills are encouraged to apply.**

Apply now to join the Smotect Azaadi sales team!

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Principal Partner Sales Executive
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global Partners Organization (GPO) builds and grows the partner ecosystem that helps Workday and our customers succeed. We work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Services, Marketing, and Product teams to generate and influence pipeline, prepare partners to deliver great work, and give customers a consistent experience no matter which partner they work with.
   

  

 Joining GPO in India means helping shape a fast\-growing ecosystem from the ground up: you'll work across a diverse set of partners, from global system integrators to emerging AI and value\-added reseller partners, and see the direct impact of your work on Workday's growth in the region.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Principal Partner Sales Executive, you will own execution across a defined portfolio of partners in India. You will manage day\-to\-day partner relationships, run joint go\-to\-market plans, and help partners meet their pipeline and revenue goals. You'll work closely with the India sales team so that partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced opportunities move smoothly from first conversation to close.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

  

* Work with partners and the India sales team to build and progress pipeline, and manage partner\-related deals through to close.
* Prepare partner sales teams on Workday's offerings and go\-to\-market approach, and help partners earn and maintain the certifications they need.
* Build and run joint go\-to\-market plans with your partners, including regular business reviews and executive check\-ins to track progress and address risks.
* Identify and onboard new referral, alliance, and global systems integrator partners, as well as AI, Workday GO, FINS, and value\-added reseller partners for the region.
* Connect partner leaders with Workday's Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services teams to build alignment on plans for individual accounts and industries.
* Serve as the main point of contact for your partner portfolio, including for day\-to\-day questions or issues that come up.


**About You**
 Basic Qualifications
   

  

* 10\+ years of relevant experience in technology sales, channel sales, or alliance management, ideally within the SaaS or enterprise software industry.
* Experience managing partner relationships and joint go\-to\-market plans that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.


**Other Qualifications**
* Channel partner management: You've built and managed relationships with partners, including recruiting new partners and helping them grow their practice and delivery quality.
* Deal and pipeline management: You're comfortable managing opportunities from early pipeline through to close, and have a track record of meeting sourcing and influencing targets.
* Go\-to\-market planning: You've built and run joint plans with partners across industries, including business reviews and governance to track progress.
* Relationship building and stakeholder alignment: You connect people across organizations, building trust and alignment between partner and internal teams at all levels, including senior leaders.
* Business development: You've identified and brought on new types of partners (for example, in AI or emerging technology areas) to expand a company's reach into new markets or segments.
* Comfort with data and tools: You're familiar with CRM and partner\-tracking tools (for example, SFDC or Partner Center) and are comfortable using data to prepare partner reviews and guide decisions; experience with Sigma is a plus.


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.
   

  

 Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
   

  

 If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Hiwaga Makers is a 360° advertising and marketing agency that supports businesses with strategy, creative execution, and integrated media solutions across digital and traditional platforms. The team designs performance\-focused campaigns spanning marketing strategy, content and brand development, video production, social media management, influencer marketing, PR support, and OOH advertising. Based in Kottayam, Kerala, Hiwaga Makers has partnered with over 200 clients in healthcare, retail, hospitality, personal brands, education, and lifestyle sectors across 6 countries. The agency emphasizes structured, intentional marketing aligned with business goals, prioritizing clarity, systems, and long\-term partnerships over short\-term noise. Applicants joining Hiwaga Makers will work in an environment that treats marketing as a system built for sustainable growth and collaboration.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Business Development Manager is a full\-time hybrid role based in Kottayam, with flexibility for some work\-from\-home arrangements. This role is responsible for identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, nurturing leads, and building long\-term client relationships across multiple industries and markets. Day\-to\-day tasks include prospecting and outreach, conducting discovery meetings, preparing proposals and presentations, coordinating with internal strategy and creative teams, and managing the sales pipeline using CRM tools. The Business Development Manager will analyze market trends, collaborate on campaign pitches, negotiate contracts, and ensure smooth handover from closing deals to account management. The role also involves setting growth targets, tracking performance metrics, and representing Hiwaga Makers at events, online meetings, and partner engagements to drive structured, sustainable revenue growth.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Business development and sales skills, including prospecting, lead qualification, client relationship management, and deal negotiation.
* Marketing and advertising knowledge, with understanding of digital campaigns, social media, content marketing, and integrated media solutions.
* Strategic thinking and analytical skills to assess market opportunities, interpret campaign performance data, and align solutions with client business goals.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to conduct discovery calls, pitch proposals, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Organizational and planning abilities, including pipeline management, CRM usage, documentation, and time management in a fast\-paced environment.
* Relevant bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in an agency, media, or marketing services environment is preferred; familiarity with industries such as healthcare, retail, or hospitality is an advantage.
* Comfort working in a hybrid setup from Kottayam, with readiness for client meetings, occasional travel, and collaboration across remote and in\-office teams.

title: SAT Counsellor – International Sales (US Market)
description:
**About the Role** 




 As an SAT Counsellor, you'll own the full sales cycle for our SAT test\-prep offering in the US market — engaging prospective students and parents, understanding their college\-admissions goals, and consultatively closing them into the right program. This is a target\-driven, individual\-contributor closing role where your product knowledge, empathy and communication skills directly drive enrollments and revenue.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Engage prospective students and parents in the US market via calls, video counselling, instant messaging (WhatsApp) and other channels to sell ACE Academy's SAT test\-prep courses.
* Understand each student's college\-admissions goals, academic background and timeline, and recommend the most suitable SAT program through consultative selling.
* Own the complete sales funnel from lead qualification and product demonstration to closing, enrollment and post\-sale relationship.
* Drive conversions through effective follow\-ups, strong objection handling, and clear articulation of the value of our SAT prep.
* Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly enrollment and revenue targets.
* Handle high\-value / premium student profiles while maintaining an exceptional customer experience.
* Maintain accurate lead, activity and pipeline records in the CRM.
* Deliver a student\-first experience that generates referrals and repeat business.



  





**Requirements \& Qualifications** 



* 2–5 years of experience selling SAT / test\-prep or study\-abroad courses to US consumers (international EdTech sales strongly preferred).
* Bachelor's degree (graduation) in any discipline is required.
* Proven, documented track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth as an individual contributor.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication fluency is essential for engaging US students and parents.
* Strong understanding of the cultural nuances and buying behaviour of US\-based students and families.
* Ability to listen effectively, build trust, and approach prospects with patience and empathy.
* Proficiency with CRM tools / sales tracking software and basic MS Office.
* Familiarity with the SAT, US college\-admissions process, or the test\-prep industry is a strong added advantage.
* Comfortable working a 6\-day week on a US\-aligned night shift, including weekends.
* High\-energy, self\-motivated and results\-oriented, able to work fast and independently in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary plus uncapped performance\-based incentives.
* The chance to sell a Forbes\-recognised, globally trusted education brand.
* Warm, high\-intent leads from a large international market.
* WFH flexibility
